plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, optical modules, disk usage, sessions/connections, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 35047).
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the overall chassis CPU utilization of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfSysCpuCostRate, IANA PEN 35047), reported directly as a percentage. Sustained high CPU usage may indicate heavy traffic inspection load or an attack.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the overall memory utilization of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfSysMemoryUsage), reported directly as a percentage. High memory pressure can degrade session-handling performance.

metrics.name: firewall_current_connections
metrics.description: This metric reports the number of current concurrent sessions tracked by the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfNewSessions, IANA PEN 35047). A rapid rise can indicate a connection flood or session-table pressure.

metrics.name: firewall_new_sessions_per_sec
metrics.description: This metric reports the current new-session establishment rate of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfNewSessionPerSec), already a per-second gauge. A sustained spike can indicate a connection flood.

metrics.name: firewall_max_sessions
metrics.description: This metric reports the maximum concurrent session capacity of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfTotalSessions). Combined with current concurrent sessions it gauges remaining session-table headroom.

metrics.name: firewall_nat_tcp_port_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports NAT4 TCP source-port utilization of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfNat4TCPLocalPortUsage) as a percentage per NAT rule. Approaching 100% means new TCP translations may fail.

metrics.name: firewall_nat_udp_port_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports NAT4 UDP source-port utilization of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfNat4UDPLocalPortUsage) as a percentage per NAT rule. Approaching 100% means new UDP translations may fail.

metrics.name: device_disk_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports per-filesystem disk utilization of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfDiskUsedPercent), reported directly as a percentage. A nearly full disk can prevent logging and configuration changes.

metrics.name: device_disk_size
metrics.description: This metric reports per-filesystem disk size of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfIntDiskSize, device unit MB, converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_disk_used
metrics.description: This metric reports per-filesystem used disk space of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfIntDiskUsed, device unit MB, converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports SFP/optical-module temperature of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfSFPTemperature) in degrees Celsius. Abnormally high values may indicate a failing optic or poor airflow at that port.

metrics.name: device_optical_tx_power
metrics.description: This metric reports SFP laser output power of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfSFPLaserOutputPower). Abnormal transmit power may indicate an aging or failing optical module.

metrics.name: device_optical_rx_power
metrics.description: This metric reports SFP receiver power of the Sangfor NGAF/AF8 firewall (Sangfor private MIB sfSFPReceiverPower). Abnormally low receive power may indicate link attenuation, dirty fiber, or a faulty peer transmitter.

metrics.name: interface_ifAdminStatus
metrics.description: This metric indicates the administrative status of the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifOperStatus
metrics.description: This metric reflects the actual operational status of the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifSpeed
metrics.description: This metric indicates the maximum data transmission speed supported by the network interface.

metrics.name: interface_ifInErrors
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of incoming error packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutErrors
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing error packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInDiscards
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of incoming discarded packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutDiscards
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing discarded packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInUcastPkts
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of incoming unicast packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutUcastPkts
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of outgoing unicast packets over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes.
